title: Resolution urging Albany to classify medical examiner vehicles as emergency vehicles
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass A.11075, the "Who You Gonna Call? Act," the Senate to pass a companion bill and the Governor to sign it. The legislation would classify Office of Chief Medical Examiner vehicles as authorized emergency vehicles, letting them use emergency lights and be treated as emergency responders at scenes. Supporters say this would speed up OCME response times to deaths, disasters and other emergency scenes.
